description_en: Performs a paged query on the scheduling monitoring and alerting configuration list. Supports filtering by project, monitored object type, alerting cause, notification method, recipient, creator, on-call schedule, logical table or field, and keyword. Online version: v6.4.0
description_zh: 分页查询调度监控告警配置列表，支持按项目、监控对象类型、告警原因、接收方式、接收人、创建人、值班表、逻辑表/字段及关键字过滤，上线版本：v6.4.0
name: ListScheduleMonitor

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the operator
parameters.name: op_user_id

fields.help_en: The list of alert cause types. Valid values: FAILED (the task execution failed), TIME_OUT (the task execution timed out), UNFINISHED (the task did not generate output), SUCCESS (the task execution succeeded), and DATA_DELAY (the data is delayed)
fields.help_zh: 告警原因类型列表：FAILED-任务运行失败，TIME_OUT-任务运行超时，UNFINISHED-任务未产出，SUCCESS-任务运行成功，DATA_DELAY-数据延迟
fields.name: alert_reason_list

fields.help_en: The keyword for search. Supports fuzzy matching for monitored task names. If this parameter is empty or not specified, no filtering is applied
fields.help_zh: 关键字搜索，支持监控任务名称模糊匹配。为空或不传时不过滤
fields.name: key_word

fields.help_en: The list of logical field IDs
fields.name: logic_field_id_list

fields.help_en: The list of logical table IDs
fields.name: logical_table_id_list

fields.help_en: The list of on-call schedule IDs
fields.name: on_call_table_list

fields.help_en: The list of user IDs of the creators of monitored objects
fields.help_zh: 监控对象创建人用户ID列表
fields.name: owner_list

fields.help_en: The current page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
fields.help_zh: 当前页码，从1开始，不传默认1
fields.name: page_no

fields.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
fields.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The list of project IDs. If this parameter is empty, all projects that the current user has permissions on are automatically queried
fields.help_zh: 项目ID列表，为空时自动查询当前用户有权限的所有项目
fields.name: project_ids

fields.help_en: The list of notification method types. Valid values: PHONE (phone call), MESSAGE (text message), EMAIL (email), DING_TALK (DingTalk), FEISHU (Lark), WECHAT (WeChat), and CUSTOM (custom channel)
fields.help_zh: 接收方式类型列表：PHONE-电话，MESSAGE-短信，EMAIL-邮件，DING_TALK-钉钉，FEISHU-飞书，WECHAT-微信，CUSTOM-自定义渠道
fields.name: received_way_type_list

fields.help_en: The list of user IDs of the recipients
fields.name: receiver_list

fields.help_en: The list of monitored object types. Valid values: LOGICAL_FIELD (logical field), OND_ID_NODE (logical table node), SCHEDULE_PHYSICAL_NODE (periodically scheduled physical task), MANUAL_PHYSICAL_NODE (manually scheduled physical task), ODM_NODE (source path task), LOGICAL_TABLE_NODE (logical table task), and PROJECT (project)
fields.help_zh: 监控对象类型列表：LOGICAL_FIELD-逻辑字段，OND_ID_NODE-逻辑表节点，SCHEDULE_PHYSICAL_NODE-周期调度物理任务，MANUAL_PHYSICAL_NODE-手动调度物理任务，ODM_NODE-贴源路径任务，LOGICAL_TABLE_NODE-逻辑表任务，PROJECT-项目
fields.name: type_list

parameters.help_zh: 调度监控告警查询条件
